title: Rows for the 3-band compressor (CMP1, CMP3, FL02)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only (0.1 ran on a unit in GT01, 0.2 in CMP1 and CMP2, 0.3 in CMP3 to FL01). Adds 20 parameter rows, through param-grow, for the 3-band master compressor: per band (LOW, MID, HIGH) threshold, ratio, attack, release and makeup, two crossovers, and (0.3) a dry/wet mix per band. 0.2 gave them their names, ranges (ratio 0..8: 1.00 = band off, then the 8 stock ratios), new-kit defaults (the stock compressor's) and value texts (dB, Hz/kHz); 0.3 adds Low Mix, Mid Mix and High Mix (k 87..89), copied from the stock MIX row (0..127, plain number, new-kit default 0 = dry); 0.4 gives each band knob the stock compressor's glyph for its kind (it borrows the display entry of the stock THR, ATK, REL, MUP, RAT or MIX row; the crossovers keep the default dial), and nothing else. comp-ui-dn2 puts them on the MIXER view's band pages. They stay in FX slots 70..89 that no stock row uses and the stock storage does not keep (comp-link-dn2 0.2 keeps them in the kit), never p-lockable, with no MIDI CC or NRPN and no randomiser. Data only: the stock image is not changed. For dn2-cfw's CMP1, CMP3 and FL02 builds.
